expectations.evidence: Five rival hypotheses H1-H5 each carry a discriminating prediction and falsifier, e.g. "H4 — Restrained shrinkage or thermal movement (environmental). ... *Prediction:* regular crack spacing both faces, widths independent of live load, negligible closure on unloading. *Falsifier:* cracks appear only under load and close on removal." and a "## Discriminating Tests" section that states "Crack mapping and orientation (flexural vertical, diagonal shear, map pattern) separates H1–H3 from H4/H5."

"Nothing was searched or inspected; these are candidates, not findings and not a selection." and "**Pre-registered:** 2026-11-08; `candidate`; no deviations." — no hypothesis is ranked, chosen, or declared correct.
